items.name: Brockport Blitz 2027
items.information: All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. **Due to the size of the venue we must STRICTLY enforce the 1 guest per competitor limit.**

items.name: German Open 2027
items.information: In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2027 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun! Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2027 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: Glasgow Spring 2027
items.information: We will have a limit on the number of competitors for 3x3 multi-blind. Please see the 3x3 multi-blind tab for more details. 3x3 multi-blind and 3x3 Fewest moves will run at the same time. It won't be possible to register for both events. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

items.information: Welcome to Nittedal Mental Breakdown 2027. This competition only holds blindfolded events, FM and Square-1 --- Velkommen til Nittedal Mental Breakdown 2027. Denne konkurransen holder kun blind-eventer, FM og Square-1.
